title: Membership groups template
purpose: Clubs, classes, bands, community groups and small teams: create a group, hand out join codes that carry a role, run events with RSVPs and a waitlist, talk in a group thread, and keep an activity log. One deployment hosts many groups. Not for back-office records (template-workspace) or two-sided markets (template-marketplace).

security_compliance.notes: Static audit at staging (75f9eec, #189): pas check passes every hard check once APPNAME is replaced (re-run 2026-09-28; in the template itself only the placeholder check fails, by design); the manifest registers through the platform's own validation (manifest rules, :__user_id scoping, schema coherence) and the migrations pass the additive-only lint (test/template-membership.test.ts). Every group statement is scoped through a membership sub-query (PAS-DATA-007); join codes are consumable grants checked in SQL (PAS-DATA-008); the only unscoped statements are the two app-wide moderation tools admin_list_groups / admin_delete_group, gated by the app role admin (PAS-AUTH-016) and declared caller_unscoped. Fixes the base template's three known deviations (PAS-AUTH-001, PAS-UI-002, PAS-UI-007).
